solar.title: Solar installation crews
solar.lead: HeilAres rental installation crews specialize in solar park construction and are available for subcontracting to other EPC companies across Europe and Scandinavia.
paragraphs: Our crews consist of experienced project managers and qualified installers who have participated in the construction of solar parks scaling hundreds of megawatts in Estonia and Latvia. Crews can be quickly mobilized to sites across Europe, ensuring that subcontractor work does not stall due to lack of manpower.

Rental teams perform framework assembly, panel installation, DC cabling and inverter connection. Each crew works according to the client's safety requirements and project schedule. This allows EPC companies to optimize their resource utilization and take on larger projects without increasing fixed costs.

A flexible rental model allows crews to be hired for short-term deadline work as well as longer projects. All our installers undergo regular safety training and hold the necessary certifications for working on industrial solar sites.

We offer both short-term and long-term rental solutions suitable for covering peak season work as well as for permanent partnership. Our project managers ensure that work meets all shipbuilding safety and quality standards.

hero.title: Solar panel services
hero.subtitle: Turnkey ground-mount, rooftop and tracker solar parks for B2B clients in Estonia, Latvia and across Europe.

ground.title: Ground-mount park
ground.lead: A ground-mount park is a land-based solar park that HeilAres designs and installs on a turnkey basis at commercial and industrial scale.
paragraphs: Ground-mount parks are ideal for agricultural land, brownfield sites and industrial plots with enough open area to install panels at the optimal tilt. HeilAres handles the installation — foundations, mounting structures, and panel and inverter installation.

We deliver installations from a few MW up to hundreds of MW. Ground-mount parks installed with the HeilAres team include the 76 MW Kirikmäe park in Estonia and the 72.5 MW Stelpe park in Latvia. We only work with Tier-1 panel and inverter manufacturers to guarantee long-term yield and reliability.
The strengths of a ground-mount park are easy maintenance, high yield and flexible scalability.

faq.question: How much land is required for a ground-mount park?
faq.lead: 1 MW of ground-mount capacity typically requires 1–1.5 hectares of land.
faq.answer: Exact land requirement depends on panel type, tilt angle and row spacing.

roof.title: Rooftop park
roof.lead: A rooftop park is a solar installation on industrial buildings, warehouses and commercial properties that HeilAres delivers on all roof types.
paragraphs: Rooftop parks suit both flat and pitched roofs — trapezoidal sheet, sandwich panel, bitumen and membrane roofs. Every project starts with a structural assessment to confirm the roof can safely carry the additional weight of panels and mounting structures.

HeilAres crews work to minimise disruption to the client's operations. We schedule around your production calendar, use safe lifting equipment and plan installation logistics so warehouse and factory operations keep running.
A rooftop park significantly reduces a company's electricity costs and CO2 footprint by using otherwise unused surface. On larger industrial buildings, rooftop capacity can reach several megawatts.

faq.question: Is my roof suitable for solar panels?
faq.lead: Most industrial roofs are suitable for solar panels if the structure can carry an additional load of 15–25 kg/m².
faq.answer: HeilAres evaluates each roof individually — covering type, age, structural capacity and shading obstacles. Every quote includes a load-bearing assessment.

tracker.title: Solar Tracker Park
tracker.lead: A Solar Tracker Park is a single-axis sun-tracking solar park that delivers up to 25% higher energy yield compared to fixed-tilt panels.
paragraphs: Solar Tracker Park systems rotate the panels east to west during the day, following the sun. This keeps the panels at the optimal angle to solar irradiation from morning to evening and significantly increases annual energy yield compared to classic fixed ground-mount parks.

Solar Tracker Parks are ideal for large open land areas with stable soil and enough space to avoid shading between rows. HeilAres has built Solar Tracker Parks in both Estonia and Latvia, including the 244 MW Risti Solar Tracker Park in Estonia and the Lielvarde Solar Tracker Park in Latvia.
Higher yield means faster payback and a better production profile across the day, which is especially valuable during peak electricity spot prices.

faq.question: How much more energy does a Solar Tracker Park produce vs a fixed ground-mount?
faq.lead: Solar Tracker Parks generate on average 15–25% more energy than equally sized fixed ground-mount parks.
faq.answer: The exact uplift depends on location, latitude and local weather. In Northern European conditions a typical gain is around 20%.

what.title: What is BESS?
what.p1: BESS, or Battery Energy Storage System, stores electrical energy for use when it is needed most.
what.p2: BESS can be integrated with a solar park, a company electrical system or other energy infrastructure.
what.p3: Storage is not only about holding energy; it makes the whole energy system more flexible and controllable.

what.question: What is BESS?
what.answer: BESS is a battery-based energy storage system that stores electricity for later use according to system objectives.

uses.question: What is battery storage used for?
uses.answer: It can store solar energy, balance generation and consumption, manage peak loads and make infrastructure more flexible.

existingSolar.question: Can storage be connected to an existing solar park?
existingSolar.answer: Yes. The suitable solution depends on the existing system architecture, grid connection and project objectives.

size.question: What size battery system does my business need?
size.answer: Sizing requires the load profile, peak loads, generation capacity, grid connection and intended use—not annual consumption alone.

dimensioning.question: Can HeilAres help size the solution?
dimensioning.answer: Yes. We first map the site energy use, generation and technical conditions.

industry.question: Is BESS suitable for industry?
industry.answer: Yes. The suitable solution is determined from the site-specific consumption and generation profile.

ev.question: Can battery storage work with EV chargers?
ev.answer: Yes. It can form part of wider infrastructure including EV charging, subject to the electrical system and load profile.

electrical.question: Does HeilAres also carry out BESS electrical works?
electrical.answer: Yes. BESS electrical connection and installation can be combined with HeilAres electrical services. MTR registration TEL005181.

expansion.question: Can battery storage be expanded later?
expansion.answer: It depends on the system architecture. Known future expansion should be considered during initial infrastructure planning.

timeline.question: How long does a BESS project take?
timeline.answer: Timing depends on system size, site readiness, design, equipment availability, grid connection and approvals. The schedule is project-specific.

start.answer: Send the site details, consumption and generation information, and available electrical or grid-connection documents. We can then assess the requirements.
